free_tier.stated: Per-TB-month, globally distributed; $5 minimum monthly fee

egress.terms: Metered at $7/TB — verbatim "Egress $7/TB" on both Standard and Advanced. No free allowance, no ratio.

tooling: S3 SDKs, rclone, Uplink CLI, Object Mount
chaining: Egress must be fronted by Cloudflare or the $7/TB dominates everything.
limits_note: Advanced plan is US SOC2 datacenters only and priced per license at $10/TB. Free trial is 30 days only (the free tier is already recorded as dead in BRIEF 1.2).
reliability_note: Erasure-coded across tens of thousands of storage nodes — the best durability-per-dollar in the set, but the egress term is exactly the wrong shape for a serving workload.
